name: EEGNet
title: EEGNet: a compact convolutional neural network for EEG-based brain–computer interfaces

verification.status: Primary abstract and indexed journal metadata verified.

evidence_scope: P300, ERN, MRCP and SMR; within-subject and cross-subject experiments; no PROTEUS evidence.

name: DeepConvNet
title: Deep learning with convolutional neural networks for EEG decoding and visualization

verification.status: Primary full text and publication metadata verified; D02 and D03 are different architectures from one paper.

evidence_scope: BCI Competition IV-2a and High-Gamma movement dataset; not direct PROTEUS validation.

name: ShallowConvNet
title: Deep learning with convolutional neural networks for EEG decoding and visualization

verification.status: Primary full text and publication metadata verified; D02 and D03 are different architectures from one paper.

evidence_scope: Same publication and data as D02; distinct band-power-oriented architecture.

name: FBMSNet
title: FBMSNet: A Filter-Bank Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Network for EEG-Based Motor Imagery Decoding

verification.status: Primary abstract and issue metadata verified; DOI contains early-access year 2022, issue year is 2023.

evidence_scope: BCI Competition IV-2a and OpenBMI; supervised MI hold-out evaluation.

name: EEG-TCNet
title: EEG-TCNet: An Accurate Temporal Convolutional Network for Embedded Motor-Imagery Brain–Machine Interfaces
venue: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)

verification.status: Peer-reviewed author accepted manuscript and IEEE conference record verified.

evidence_scope: BCI Competition IV-2a plus MOABB experiments over 12 MI datasets; conference, not premier general ML venue.

name: ATCNet
title: Physics-Informed Attention Temporal Convolutional Network for EEG-Based Motor Imagery Classification

verification.status: IEEE primary indexed abstract verified; issue/year cross-checked; direct open meets JavaScript challenge.

evidence_scope: MI-EEG classification; compact convolution, attention and TCN; no PROTEUS experiment.

name: EEG Conformer
title: EEG Conformer: Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding and Visualization
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering, 31, 710–719

verification.status: Primary abstract, author-hosted published PDF and issue year verified.

evidence_scope: Three public datasets across motor imagery and emotion recognition; no PROTEUS.

name: TSception
title: TSception: Capturing Temporal Dynamics and Spatial Asymmetry From EEG for Emotion Recognition

verification.status: Author accepted manuscript and author repository final citation verified; early access 2022, issue 2023.

evidence_scope: EEG emotion recognition including DEAP; temporal multiscale and spatial asymmetry; not three-command BCI.

name: DGCNN
title: EEG Emotion Recognition Using Dynamical Graph Convolutional Neural Networks

verification.status: Primary IEEE abstract and accepted manuscript verified; early access 2018, issue 2020.

evidence_scope: SEED subject-dependent and subject-independent emotion recognition; DREAMER affect dimensions.

name: RGNN
title: EEG-Based Emotion Recognition Using Regularized Graph Neural Networks

verification.status: Primary author manuscript and implementation verified; final issue metadata cross-checked; IEEE direct open challenged. Early access 2020, issue 2022.

evidence_scope: SEED and SEED-IV emotion recognition; graph priors plus NodeDAT and EmotionDL; target-use setting must be separated.

name: LGGNet

venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, 35(7), 9773–9786

verification.status: Primary abstract and author accepted manuscript verified; final issue 2024, early access 2023.

evidence_scope: Public attention, driving-fatigue and DEAP datasets; four classification tasks including emotion/preference.
